overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long TEM Daily ETF (TEMT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in health care equity. The fund provides 2x exposure, minus fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of Tempus AI Inc. (TEM) stock. TEMT was launched on May 12, 2025 and is issued by Tradr.
